name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen and bathroom walls?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for kitchen and bathroom walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen and bathroom walls, paints designed to withstand high humidity and frequent cleaning are recommended. Satin or semi-gloss finishes are often preferred due to their durability and ease of cleaning, resisting moisture and mildew better than flat finishes. Many manufacturers offer paints specifically formulated for these high-moisture environments, often labeled as 'kitchen and bath' paints, which contain mildewcides. These paints help maintain a fresh appearance and prolong the life of the paint job in areas prone to splashes and steam.
acceptedAnswer.description: Satin or semi-gloss paints are best for kitchens and bathrooms due to their durability, ease of cleaning, and resistance to moisture and mildew.
